pages.text: Start actions in assembly order. A child's scheduled delay does not automatically make later actions wait.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: Only the connected nodes contribute; this node adds no mana fee.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: Add the complexity costs of the connected nodes.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).
